Definition: apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally):--ear.
BiblicalUsage: The ear hears what the eye cannot see. Paul says eye has not seen, nor ear heard, the things God has prepared for them that love Him, and Peter says the ears of the Lord are open unto the prayers of the righteous.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the ear is the organ of faith: what I hear shapes what I believe, and the Lord's ears are open to the prayers of the righteous.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
